node: Student-loan, Title IV, accreditation, state authorization, and education compliance rails
summary: Layer 1B expands the universe around education regulatory and finance rails rather than obvious school operators. The strongest public-market mappings found in this pass are federal student-loan servicing contractors, education-focused payment and receivables infrastructure, and higher-ed administrative systems that touch financial aid, billing, student records, and compliance reporting. The underfollowed angle is that these companies may benefit from regulatory complexity, financial-aid workflow modernization, repayment-plan changes, international-student payment friction, and audit-readiness needs even when they are not classified as education companies.
